The name of this Arcana is a reference to the song "

by casting the spell "latorre", which means "the tower" in Italian.
This makes Slash (XVI) a representation of
Major Arcana card, symbolizing sudden upheaval, premonition, ill omens, chaos, disaster, and destruction.
This is reflected with the brush stroke being a line in the middle and in its ability to grant the player's bladed weapons the chance of dealing or increasing critical damage.
The name and sprite of this Arcana is also a reference to "

. By stroking a horizontal line of ink across some objects, it will cut them in half. While the sprite does not show a horizontal line, it is still an ink trail. Its effect also has the theme of dealing damage as Power Slash is used to deal supplementary damage while in combat.
The weapons that Slash can affect are traditionally melee weapons that can cause laceration (which is almost all of them in the displayed list of weapons), fitting for its name.
This may explain why it does not affect
, which is a boomerang without sharp edges in Castlevania that bludgeons enemies, while Heaven Sword is affected.
